findings.evidence: HalfPlane/Basic.lean:134 `IntegrableOn.mono_set (φ.integrable_inner (h.locallyIntegrableOn.restrict_of_inter Ω.isOpen (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_im))) fun _ hz => le_of_lt hz`; TestFunction/Inner.lean:66 `theorem integrable_inner {w : E → V} (hw : LocallyIntegrableOn w Ω μ) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, V))` (any μ); LocallyIntegrable.lean:336 `LocallyIntegrableOn.restrict_of_inter`.
findings.fix: Delete it and inline `IntegrableOn.mono_set (φ.integrable_inner ((hw.locallyIntegrableOn le_rfl (Ω.isOpen.isLocallyClosed_inter_setOfPred_le_im 0)).restrict_of_inter Ω.isOpen (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_im))) fun _ hz => le_of_lt hz` at its uses, or take `LocallyIntegrableOn` hypotheses directly.
findings.issue: Private `integrableOn_im_pos_inner` reproves the integrability of `⟪φ, w⟫` on `{0 < im}` by hand (compact set, `of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero`). Existing TestFunction and locally-integrable API already gives this.

findings.evidence: TestFunction/Inner.lean:72 `theorem integrable_inner_fderiv {w : E → V} (hw : LocallyIntegrableOn w Ω μ) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, V)) (v : E) : Integrable (fun x => ⟪fderiv ℝ (φ : E → V) x v, w x⟫_ℝ) μ`.
findings.fix: Delete it and use `IntegrableOn.mono_set (φ.integrable_inner_fderiv (… .restrict_of_inter Ω.isOpen (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_im)) v) fun _ hz => le_of_lt hz`, the same pattern as above.
findings.issue: Private `integrableOn_im_pos_inner_fderiv` is the same duplicate for `⟪∂_v φ, w⟫`. It goes through `lineDerivCLM`, which `TestFunction.integrable_inner_fderiv` already does.

summary: The Sobolev half-plane Green formula and the boundary linearization are new and reuse the existing scalar half-plane integration-by-parts lemmas, but the two private integrability helpers reprove what `TestFunction.integrable_inner`/`integrable_inner_fderiv` plus `LocallyIntegrableOn.restrict_of_inter` already give, as `IsWeakCRSolutionHalf.integrableOn_inner` does in one line.
